inputs.text: A ceasefire is not peace if it rewards force and hands Tehran more leverage over the Strait of Hormuz. Iran’s five counter-conditions make clear how far apart the sides remain, and Israel should not be pressured to give up its ability to defend its people against future threats. The US should stand firm: any settlement must protect security and stability, not legitimize coercion or make a vital passage more vulnerable. Without order and credible defenses, families and nations alike are left exposed.
